Read all five refutation steps. At N=3 doubling swaps [1],[2] and fixes [0], while its +1 translate also permutes all three classes; attempted branch images overlap everywhere. No integer M has 2M=3, so the asserted N/2 domains do not exist. This refutes the universal partition/reduction without challenging direct DFT evaluation. For arbitrary odd N=2q+1, [q+1] inverts [2]; for even N the correct map has domain Z/M, as stated by the earlier supplier.
